name: Ethwebs Floating Chat Button with Page Link
author: Sanmatiraj

sections.description: This plugin adds a clean, responsive floating chat shortcut button to your WordPress site. Through a dedicated settings panel, you can easily control your target phone number, change button alignment, write custom greeting text, set display rules, manage WooCommerce visibility, and toggle whether the current page URL is automatically attached to your message window.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Chat Button to configure parameters.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Added global page and post display rule toggles.
  • Added specific page/post ID exclusion options.
  • Added per-page sidebar checkbox control inside the WordPress page editor.
  • Added dedicated WooCommerce controls for hiding buttons on Cart/Checkout pages.

short_description: Adds a lightweight, responsive floating chat button layout to your design, branded securely by Ethwebs.
